bugs_found: fx_convert divides by FX rate instead of multiplying, producing systematically wrong conversions
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal, so floats can raise TypeError or introduce inconsistent behavior compared with other functions
compound_interest allows negative principal while loan_payment rejects negative principal, an undeclared inconsistent money validation
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), causing silent under-calculation for fractional inputs
no finite-number validation: NaN/Infinity inputs can raise unexpected Decimal errors or propagate invalid monetary values
monetary outputs are never rounded/quantized to currency precision, allowing fractional-cent balances and receipts
transfer is non-atomic: if crediting account_to.balance fails after debiting account_from.balance, balances become inconsistent
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction amount
